panels.title: ⚖️ Payment-service RPS per Instance (LB distribution)
panels.description: Shows how Nginx distributes requests between payment-service and payment-service-2. Equal bars = perfect load balance. Only populated when --profile lb is active.

panels.title: ⏱ Payment-service P50/P95 Latency per Instance
panels.description: Per-instance latency comparison. Diverging lines indicate one instance is slower — useful for detecting an unhealthy replica behind the LB.
